articleTitle: Urban Waterlogging Area Planning Based on Computer and GIS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Urban flood disaster caused by heavy rain is the main natural disaster faced by cities, which not only seriously affects the traffic of cities, but also threatens the life and property safety of urban residents. Research on urban inundated area planning can effectively deal with the loss caused by urban flood disaster. In this study, one-dimensional and two-dimensional coupled hydrodynamic simulation model of urban area was established by using computer and GIS technology, and the rainfall return period of 5-year, 10-year, 20-year and 50-year was selected for simulation study. The simulation results were planned and displayed by GIS. The main conclusions are as follows: the coupling model of one-dimensional and two-dimensional hydrodynamics can be used to model the rainfall confluence process in urban areas. The combination of computer technology and GIS technology can provide scientific basis and technical support for urban flood control and drainage and inundation area planning, and the simulation results can be shown accurately and vividly. With the increase of rainfall recurrence period, the inundation range and the number of inundation risk points in the study area increased, and the inundation range in the same risk area expanded. Together, this modeling and evaluation method can help city management committees assess the potential risk of urban waterlogging, particularly in areas with high risk of waterlogging under extreme rainfall that may occur in the future.

articleTitle: Efficient Task Scheduling in Cloud Environment Based on Hyper Min Max Task Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The growing field of cloud computing deals with large tasks for processing resources. From the application point of view, the research on task scheduling mechanism of data transfer in large-scale cloud computing environment is relatively poor. Unbalanced scheduling leads to traffic overload, energy loss, and failure of hardware control. In addition, residential appliances do not consider delay reduction in power consumption. Hence, Internet of Things (IoT) dominates the current trends in the Internet. The large number of things (things) associated with the Internet creates a large amount of information that requires a lot of effort and work preparation to make it valuable. To resolve this problem, we propose a Hyper Min max task scheduling (HMMTS) based in cascade shrink priority (CSP) to allocate task to optimize the scheduling. With intent a Changeover Load Balancer (CLB) and The Preemptive Flow Manager (PFM) is responsible for the application of load balancing strategy based on the mixed load balancing algorithm improves the task allocation better to balance load to improve the response time. Experimental results have been demonstrated with respect to better load balancing, lower power rate, and time consumption rate in both phase and random uniform propagation. Simulated results performance of this process can reduce data processing time and achieve load neutralization.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Health Supervision System for Immobile patients
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With each passing day there are advancements in science and its technology, but people are still unable to utilize them properly because of their busy schedules or not being aware of the technologies, which several times results in loss of patient’s lives. Our proposed model is designed for continuous monitoring of patient’s basic health parameters such as heart rate, blood oxygen level, and room conditions such as levels of CO2 gas, room temperature and humidity which are displayed on an LCD. The proposed model has an alert system in the form of sending SMS to the registered number whenever a toxic gas is detected thereby notifying patient’s caretaker before unfortunate incident takes place. The model also aims to help people who are old aged, deaf, dumb, bed-ridden and having paralyzed effects by designing a glove which has flex sensors interfaced to it. A particular field is initialized to each flex sensor, whenever the patient wearing the glove bends the finger, flex sensor gets twisted and the field attached to it is played on the speaker. Hence the glove is used for easy and effective communication between the patient and their caretaker.

articleTitle: An Analysis System Based on Improved ID3 Algorithm for Sports Effect Evaluation Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Sport data is an important part of large data resources, and the collection and analysis of sport data can be effective in understanding the effects of sport on the human body and the effects of sport. The purpose of this paper is to study the analysis system of sports effect evaluation methods based on the improved ID3 algorithm. Starting from the study of data mining algorithms, the adaptation effects of different sports are studied and a sports effect evaluation dataset is constructed. An improved ID3 algorithm is proposed for studying the effects of sports on the body and provides a simple and easy to use system for analysing the effects of sports. According to the results of the study and analysis, it was found that the effects of different types of sports on the body of adolescents varied greatly.

articleTitle: Construction of Smart Pension System for Urban and Rural Residents Based on Big Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Population aging is a social problem that every country cannot avoid in the process of modernization. China has rapidly stepped into the threshold of an aging society. With the deepening of the aging of the population and with the increasing demand for diversified services for the elderly, there is an urgent need to provide multi-level, high-quality elderly care(ec) services for the elderly. There is a large gap in human resources and other resources in the traditional pension industry. The pension industry needs to develop. Zhiyi pension has opened a new realm of the pension model. It cannot only provide a variety of life assistance, Rehabilitation care, psychological comfort and social support services for the elderly through intelligent decision-making and control, but also always protect the safety of the elderly and meet the multi-level and diversified service The needs of urban and rural elderly. We should play the leading comprehensive role of innovation driving role of information technology, accelerate the development of smart health care industry, improve people's livelihood and cultivate new economic drivers, On the 23rd of 2017, the Ministry of Industry, Information Technology and Information Technology, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Health and Family Planning Commission jointly issued the Action Plan for the Development of Smart ec Industry (2017-2022), which explicitly mentioned the year 2022, It will "basically form a smart health care industry system covering the whole life cycle. So far, the Smart Pension (SM) industry has completed its overall layout and entered the practical level.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Bridge Construction Project Based on Fast ICA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the growth of China's economy, the scale of infrastructure construction is expanding, and the investment risk is also increasing. This paper establishes the risk rating model of bridge engineering project based on Fast ICA model. Firstly, this paper introduces the risk management of bridge engineering project, then expounds the concept, principles and methods of project safety risk identification, and then studies the appliance of fast ICA algorithm. Based on this, a series of related designs are carried out, and the risk identification simulation test of the model is carried out. Finally, the test results show that the risk assessment rate of the model for foundation pit, extreme weather, heavy tools, bridge quality and geological conditions is more than 75%, which shows that the risk assessment model of bridge engineering project based on Fast ICA algorithm can effectively assess the project, and the accuracy is very high, which can meet the needs of users. This article provides more theoretical basis for project risk analysis by evaluating the risk of bridge construction projects using the fast ICA algorithm, and plays an important role in reducing the risk of bridge construction projects and promoting the better development of bridge construction.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Phase/Frequency Detector in a Complete PLL System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In many integrated radio frequency (RF) transceivers, the phase-locked loop (PLL) serves as a frequency synthesizer. This work goes to test various different phase/frequency detector blocks with a standard charge pump and Voltage controlled oscillator design. These include the comparison of different phase-frequency detectors (PFD) based upon D-flipflops, latches (Latch PFD) & pass transistors (PTPFD) to the more complex Pre-charged PFD. The best results of the PFDs in the PLL system in order are Pre-charge PFD, PT-PFD, Latch PFD and D-flipflop PFD. A charge pump PLL (CPLL) with a frequency range of [80 MHz -800 MHz] is simulated using Cadence Virtuoso (Spectre) at 180nm technology (scl\_pdk) with 1.8 V supply voltage. The phase noise of the VCO is less than -50dBc/Hz at 10MHz and is closer to 110dBc/Hz at 1GHz.

articleTitle: MTPE Model Translation Course Recommendations Based on Mobile Cloud Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As long as translators adapt to new technologies and are willing to learn new skills and adapt to the evolving needs of the market, the translation industry will continue to thrive. The purpose of this paper is to study MTPE model translation course recommendation based on mobile cloud computing technology. The characteristics of mobile cloud computing and distributed cloud computing translation course recommendation services and algorithms are studied. On the basis of machine translation, a classification system of error types (science and technology, humanities, medical articles) is established to guide students to identify machine translation errors, evaluate and make statistics and analysis on students' cognitive ability of translation quality and post-translation editing ability, and propose corresponding teaching strategies. After using the MTPE model based on mobile cloud technology for experimental teaching, the overall recognition rate of students is significantly improved, and the average number of vocabulary recognition errors is 88 and 23 times more than before experimental teaching. The average number of grammatical meaning recognition errors is 50 or 9 times more than that before experimental teaching. The recognition rate of contextual meaning is the highest, with an average of 86 errors. Other errors average 82; There are an average of 69 style correction questions. This shows that this technology can improve the students' error recognition rate and improve the learning effect.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Support Vector Machine for the Evaluation and Optimization of Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Evaluation optimization is the major content of financial management, but in the evaluation and optimization process, the number of financial data and evaluation means will affect the outputs, decrease the accuracy of evaluation optimization, and lead to errors in optimization results. Rest on this, this paper develops a support vector machine technique to evaluate and optimize financial management, maximize the level of financial management, and shrink the evaluation and optimization time. Then, a comprehensive assessment of financial management is carried out. Finally, vector computing manages evaluation optimization and outputs the optimization outputs. The simulation outputs of MATLAB represent that the support vector machine method can accurately evaluate and optimize, improve the level of financial management, and the evaluation and optimization accuracy is more significant than 92%, which is better than the vector calculation method. At the same time, the results of the support vector machine technique developed in this paper have a small change range, less than 3.6%, which is superior to the original calculation method. In addition, in the financial management, support vector machine method for data processing time is less than 5 seconds, better than manual evaluation method. Therefore, the support vector machine method can meet the evaluation necessity of financial management and is perfect for optimal financial management analysis.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Algorithm for Optimization of the Path of Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of financial management and shorten the optimization time of management path, this paper proposes a data mining algorithm. Firstly, the big data theory is used to process financial management data, eliminate the irrelevant attributes of the data, and form a financial management collection. Then, use audit standards, risk thresholds, and optimization strategies to continuously optimize financial management data, and identify solvency and profitability. Finally, with reference to the financial indicators and optimization thresholds, the path optimization level is determined and the optimization plan is output. The simulation results show that the data mining algorithm proposed in this paper, under the guidance of big data theory, can improve the accuracy of financial risk management and shorten the optimization time, which is significantly better than the manual audit method . In addition, the optimization degree of data mining algorithm for financial management path is more than 40%, and the optimization time is less than 15 seconds, which is superior to previous path optimization methods.Therefore, the data mining algorithm can effectively select the path of financial management and meet the requirements of path optimization.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart Disease Using Naive Bayes and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Health conditions are becoming more prevalent today as a result of hereditary and societal factors. Particularly, heart disease has been increasingly prevalent recently, putting people's lives in danger. Each person's blood pressure, cholesterol, and pulse rate are unique to them. However, medically validated results show that the normal ranges for blood pressure, cholesterol, pulse rate, and heart rate are 120/90, 100-129, 100, 60-100, and 60-100 bpm, respectively. Major vessels range in width from the aortas 25 mm (1 inch) to the capillaries 8 m. The risk level of each individual is estimated in this study using a variety of classification techniques based on variables like age, gender, blood pressure, cholesterol, and pulse rate. The user's disease is predicted via a "Disease Prediction" method based on predictive modelling using the symptoms they offer as input. The system evaluates the user's symptoms as input and outputs the likelihood that the disease will occur. Naive Bayes and particle Swarm optimization (PSO) method used to predict diseases. These methods determine the likelihood of the condition. As a result, 90% of predictions are accurate on average.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Information Technology in the Digital Transformation of Power Enterprise Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Under the deep influence of digital technology, the management of major power enterprises has entered the process of digital transformation. In this context, with the gradual development of power enterprises, the defects and problems in their management process are gradually exposed. Digital transformation requires power enterprises to face not only more complex business challenges, but also more management challenges. One of the most important problems is how to effectively solve the problem of information interaction, realize data sharing, maximize the value of resources, and comprehensively improve the management level and core competitiveness of enterprises. In order to solve this problem, based on the overview of power enterprise management, combined with computer information technology, this paper has carried out an in-depth study of its management digital transformation. To verify its effectiveness, this paper evaluates its management benefit ratio from seven aspects, including strategic management and equipment management. The result shows that the average benefit ratio of each management content under this method is about 83.6%. From the experimental results, it can be seen that computer information technology has high application value in the digital transformation of power enterprise management, which can significantly improve the efficiency of enterprise management and promote the sustainable development of power enterprise management. The computer information technology can effectively improve the management level of the enterprise, make the management work of strategy, project and resources orderly, improve the degree of information interaction inside and outside the enterprise, and promote the digital transformation and sustainable development of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Forest Cover Type Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: It is important to understand the different types of forest cover because forests are critical for decreasing air pollution, controlling greenhouse gas emissions, and preserving ecological equilibrium. So, it becomes very important to understand the types of trees present in different parts of the forest. So, using machine learning techniques, a structure is developed to entirely automate this procedure. A variety of classification algorithms were used to classify different forest cover types based on cartographic features. Supervised machine learning algorithms were used. Classification algorithms used in this study were Decision Tree Classifier, Multinomial Logistic Regression, k-Nearest Neighbors Classifier, and Random Forest Classifier. Different performance criteria were performed to measure each classifier’s performance. The Random Forest classifier outperforms the other three classifiers in this study. It helps the users classify the cover type easily without having to deal with all that data. In the end, it is integrated with the Flask framework. With the help of this classification, further research can be carried out regarding the inhabitants of forests, deforestation, forest fires, and many other concerns.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of DCVSL and MDCVSL Techniques in 18nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the VLSI design circuit, average power dissipation is a very common source of concern. This paper aims to reduce the average power dissipation and other parameters that are performed in this paper notably propagation delay, EDP (energy delay product), and PDP (Power delay product). These two technologies have been compared based on 2:1 MUX using Differential Cascode Voltage Switch Logic (DCVSL) and Modified Differential Cascode Voltage Switch Logic (MDCVSL) has been presented with FinFET 18nm technology. The results show values of Power Delay Product (PDP) and Energy Delay Product (PDP) for DCVSL based on 2:1 MUX using FinFET approach at different voltage levels notably at 1.2V is 1612.41× 10-15 (J), at 1V is 566.744× 10-15 (J) and at 0.8V is 198.177× 10-15(J). EDP of DCVSL at 1.2V is 4075.68×10-22 (Js), at 1V is 1431.36× 10-22 (Js) and 0.8V is 5047.9× 10-22 (Js) respectively. MDCVSL using 2:1 MUX has shown efficiency in terms of both EDP and PDP over DCVSL using 2:1 MUX PDP of MDCVSL at 1.2V is 1230.164× 10-15 (J), at 1V is 400.542× 10-15 (J) and at 0.8V is 137.716 × 10-15(J). EDP of MDCVSL at 1.2V is 3107.39× 10-22 (Js), at 1V is 1010.92× 10-22 (Js) and 0.8V is 3471.6× 10-22 (Js). In relation to the DCVSL approach, MDCVSL has evidenced an improved transient response and lower energy usage. Consequently, the MDCVSL is used in both industrial and biological uses, and it can be used for digital and cascading circuits.

articleTitle: The Optimization Algorithm for the Cultivation of Medical Literacy in the Era of Smart Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the era of intelligent media, society has undergone great development. For example, with the continuous innovation of modern communication technology, the role of individuals has changed, and at the same time, a series of social issues and conflicts have also been triggered. Schools are the main position for talent cultivation, and medical universities are a learning environment dedicated to serving the society. Therefore, training medical graduates in media literacy is crucial. With the advent of the era of intelligent media, scientific research has entered a new stage. Since then, there has been an increasing number of literacy research in the fields of education and medicine. The cultivation of medical literacy (ML) of medical workers conforms to the development needs of the information age. It also prepares for the cultivation of high-quality medical talents. In this paper, an acute sampling of medical staff (MS) in major hospitals in a province is used to analyze the literacy of these MS, and use the training optimization algorithm to evaluate their literacy before and after the implementation of the literacy training program. It is hoped that the research in this paper can make MS face up to their own ML problems to a certain extent, and at the same time improve various social factors that affect the formation of MS literacy to enhance their literacy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Trade Gravity Model in the National Bilateral Export Trade
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Bilateral trade refers to the trade in which two countries maintain a balance of imports and exports with each other. With the deepening of economic globalization, export trade has gradually become a major strategic issue related to the future of opening up. Therefore, the analysis of the bilateral export trade volume of a country in economic activities has important practical significance. The research improves the trade gravity model through quantile regression, and realizes parameter estimation through EM algorithm based on considering the influence of hidden variables. The results show that the minimum residuals of the parameters are 0.1489, 0.0057, 0.0049, and 0.0066, respectively, which all appear under the Logistic distribution and follow the Logistic distribution. In the analysis of the bilateral export trade volume of a country, the changes in the four quantiles 0.215, 0.515, 0.765, and 0.965 are consistent with the direction of parameter values. The economic scale and distance of the importing and exporting countries have a positive and negative impact on the bilateral export trade volume, respectively, consistent with international trade theory. The above results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and provide a methodological reference for the dynamic analysis of bilateral export trade volume of countries.

articleTitle: Intelligent Pulse Detection and Graphic Analysis of Virtual Simulation Technology in Human Movement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of digital signal processing technology and machine learning, people have begun to study and analyze the relationship between pulse signals and human physiological states and diseases. The analysis of pulse signal usually includes pulse signal acquisition, preprocessing, extraction of relevant features, classification and identification, etc. However, the pulse signal under human motion is not stable, so it is hoped to develop a method that can intelligently detect the pulse signal under human motion. system to help people monitor pulse changes. This paper uses sensor technology and virtual simulation technology (VST) to design a pulse detection (PD) system. The sensors of this system include temperature sensor and pulse condition sensor. The sensors of this system include temperature sensor and pulse sensor. The PD results can be displayed by compiling a virtual instrument platform through MATLAB, and the detection results can be displayed in the form of graphics. The recognition accuracy of the system in the three movements of jumping, running and squatting reaches more than 90%, which verifies the feasibility of the system designed in this paper in the field of PD.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Based on Social Networks Using Support Expectation-Maximization for E-Commerce Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, the use of social networks has increased rapidly. More people and companies are becoming dependent on Data Mining (DM) technology on social networking to promote the reform of unstructured data. It may be likely to put them in a systematic model. Social media has played an important role in promoting different products, generating reviews and highlighting customers' opinions. Reviews provided by the customer help to establish a good name for the product and also help to improve the quality of the product. Reviews also help customer select the best product among available products. For this reason, the provision of a particular product’s customer reviews facilitates the false-positive product review by providing a false negative of product reviews, to make it a possible downgrade which speaks about the project organization itself. The proposed Support Expectation-Maximization (SEM) algorithm is used to analyse the reviews based on sentimental lexical words to customers select the best products to resolve this problem. It collects the dataset from E-commerce online websites or applications such as Flip-kart or Amazon. The collected datasets are trained into the pre-processing process to analyse the stemming, Tokenization and Stop-word Elimination. Then, feature selection is done to select the best features of customer reviews sentiment lexical words weightages to reduce the dimensionality. A feature selection dataset is trained into the proposed Support Expectation-Maximization (SEM) algorithm to classify the reviews about the product, and it helps select the best product.

articleTitle: Evaluation of High Voltage Power Cable Accessories under Electrical Stress from Overvoltages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This study investigates the effects of overvoltage stress on the power cable joint and terminations. The cable joint and termination are subjected to electrical aging through applied overvoltages to study the influence of overvoltage. The cable joints and terminations are the main areas for degradation. To study the influence of over-voltage in XLPE insulated cables, which are widely utilized for medium and high-voltage power transmission. Experimental studies based on the dielectric power factor measurements are carried out to assess the condition of power cable joints and end terminations. The sequence of overvoltage is applied to a cable joint installed in an 11kV XLPE insulated power cable. The measurement results acknowledge the relevance of dielectric power factor measurements in evaluating how electrical surges impact the cable insulation at the HV cable joint.

articleTitle: An Innovation Development of Routing for Smart Data Traffic Environment in Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The routing for smart data traffic environment in data mining is a complex process that requires advanced algorithms to allow for efficient data collection and analysis. The process starts with the initial data collection, which involves gathering data from various sources, such as sensors, web applications, and databases. Once the data is collected, it is processed and stored in a data warehouse. This data warehouse is then analyzed to identify patterns, correlations, and anomalies in the data. From there, algorithms are used to determine the optimal route for data traffic, based on factors such as distance, time, cost, and the likelihood of successful data transfer. The routing process involves both traditional and newer methods. Traditional methods include the use of routing tables, which allow for the efficient routing of data traffic to specific nodes in a network. Other methods include the use of route optimization algorithms, which take into account the traffic loads of different nodes in a network and prioritize the routing of data traffic in an optimal manner. Newer methods of routing data traffic include Software-Defined Networking (SDN), which is a software-based approach to routing data traffic. This approach allows for the use of automated routing algorithms that can quickly adjust the routing of data traffic based on the current traffic load.

articleTitle: Influence of Autodesk Series Software on Landscape Planning and Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Landscape design involves a lot of graphic drawing and topographic survey, which is a large and complex project. The application of digital technology can simplify the workload of landscape design survey. It is very important and urgent to accelerate the theoretical and practical process of modern landscape architecture. For this reason, this paper puts forward the landscape planning and design based on Autodesk software. The research results show that after using Autodesk, the average completion time of four landscape designers is 3.525 hours, which is 29% higher than that without using Autodesk. After using Autodesk, the average document verification error of four landscape designers was 1.5, and the improvement effect reached 92%. This proves that the research based on Autodesk series software has important practical significance for landscape planning and design. It cannot only improve the speed of landscape designers editing documents, but also intelligently identify errors and improve drawing efficiency.

articleTitle: True Time Dispatch of Experimental Reliability Resources Based on Hybrid Group Intelligent Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: True time resource dispatch problem refers to how to reasonably arrange and allocate limited resources under given time constraints, so that one or several objectives are optimal, in terms of its essence, this is the process of decision-making. With the high-speed blossom of information technology, humans have higher demand for network performance, and the network itself has the characteristics of openness and dynamics, so Lots of network nodes has become more complex and diverse. Affected by many uncertain factors, the work load dynamic ̈ resource dispatch was always unexpected open environment. For the sake of enhance the robustness and dependability of the system and reduce resource consumption and task completion delay, an effective control strategy must be adopted. In the implementation of this new environment ̄ traditional control system design and implementation of the method, its characteristic is to control and dispatch phase separation, is unable to provide the necessary quality control (QOS) guarantees. Hence the need for an effective solution that can support the above requirements. On this basis, this paper will use mixed difference strategy multi-objective group intelligence algorithm and multi-direction update mixed multi-objective group intelligence method to solve the true time dispatch of resources. This model combines the advantages of two kinds of intelligent optimization algorithms and overcomes their respective disadvantages. The experiment result shows that the model based on hybrid group intelligent algorithm has higher positioning accuracy and strong generalization performance. The HIOA uses the multi-direction update strategy and the local search strategy based on the particle sequence, the convergence of the algorithm is improved obviously, and the searched solutions have good distribution performance. Therefore, the hybrid group intelligent algorithm can be more reasonable in true time resource dispatch.

articleTitle: The Aided Design of Interior Layout Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, artificial intelligence technology has gradually matured and has been widely used in the field of computer-aided design. Based on artificial intelligence, a comprehensive interactive management system conforming to the indoor layout and three-dimensional space is constructed. This paper will combine the theoretical knowledge of interior space geometric lines, virtual reality, etc., and use digital modeling methods to analyze the relationship and mutual influence factors of various elements in the two-dimensional CAD model, and establish mathematical models to achieve three-dimensional visual display, and finally complete a computer-based intelligent design environment to improve work efficiency and user experience, and then test the platform, and the test results show that, The operation reliability, safety and stability of the auxiliary tool for indoor layout based on artificial intelligence technology are very high, which can make the indoor layout design tool efficient and low error rate. Based on artificial intelligence, the layout auxiliary system is designed to meet different ages, different regions, and personalized needs. In interior layout design, AI-based layout-assisted design can effectively improve space utilization and reduce costs. Analyze different user needs and functions to determine different sizes, materials or styles. Decide the layout location and method according to customer needs.

articleTitle: A Optimization Method of Financial Management Decision with Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Decision selection is an important subject of financial management, however, in the decision selection process, it is interfered by the amount of data and management means, which reduces the rationality of decision choice and leads to wrong decision-making results. Based on this, this study introduced a method of time series to make decision-making choices on data of financial management, increase the level of financial management, and shorten the management decisionmaking time. Then the financial management data is completely analyzed. At the end, continuous monitoring is used to make management decisions and final results as the output. The results provide that the time series method can accurately make decision-making choices, increase the level of decision-making choices, and the accuracy of decision-making choices is greater than 95%, which is better than the continuous monitoring method. In addition, the accuracy and completeness of the time series algorithm proposed in this paper are higher than 90%, the decision-making time is less than 10 seconds, and the comprehensive result is higher than 85%, which is superior to the previous financial management decision-making methods, and the overall result is ideal. Therefore, the time series method can accomodated the selection necessity of financial management decisions and is acceptable for continuous analysis of financial management.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in the Digital Inheritance of Intangible Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Virtual reality visualisation design can be used as a new starting point for inheriting and preserving nontraditional heritage with authenticity and creativity. Virtual reality technology can reasonably coordinate the human-machine relationship and point out the direction of new artistic expression. The aim of this paper is to study the digital inheritance of intangible heritage based on virtual reality technology. In this paper this paper describes the whole process of digitisation of intangible cultural heritage, designs a system for digitisation of intangible cultural heritage and assesses public satisfaction. In order to improve the rendering efficiency, the LOD algorithm in Three.js was modified to make the model calls in the algorithm more reasonable by using physical conditions and user interests. Experimental results show that the algorithm can improve the rendering efficiency of the browser and improve user interaction and experience. The average human service perception was 4.6, with a standard deviation of 0.72. Therefore, virtual design improvement of intangible cultural heritage digital inheritance through virtual reality technology can effectively enhance the humanized service effect.

articleTitle: A Parameter Estimation Method for Water Quality in Time Delay System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Currently, there are many evaluation methods for large-scale systems with time delay, but the application of many intelligent devices makes the evaluation accuracy and time unsatisfactory. A parameter estimation method is proposed to aim at the complex problem of evaluation and correction of large-scale systems with time delay in industrial control. This method comprehensively analyzes the water quality detection environment, finds the reasons for the emergence of large-scale systems with time delay, and constructs a mapping time delay degree table. The degree and cause of the time delay are analyzed based on water quality data, and the comprehensive evaluation of water quality is realized. MATLAB simulation shows that the parameter estimation method has a good effect on water quality evaluation in industrial control, the accuracy rate is over 90%, and the evaluation time is less than 10s, which is superior to the previous analysis models. Therefore, the parameter estimation method is suitable for evaluating and correcting the water quality model of a large-scale system with time delay.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Lighting System for Sports Venues Based on BIM Technology and Internet of Things Background
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: My study is to analyse how optimization design of stadium lighting system with the role of BIM (building information modeling) technology and Internet of Things. On the one hand, With the expansion of the scale of construction projects and the increasingly complex management mode, BIM applications also face big challenges. on the other hand, the research of stadium lighting system is a dynamic and continuous process. The traditional data acquisition method of "measurement + reporting management" has poor real-time performance and prediction, so it is difficult to realize real-time information monitoring. Meanwhile, Majority of researchers only focus on the application of BIM in the design stage, simulated construction process and project management. The study takes an indoor basketball court in Xi 'an city as an example, the point light source, line light source and area light source were compared and analyzed, this paper compares and analyzes the point light source, line light source and area light source under the same conditions, and draws the conclusion that line light source can better meet the actual lighting requirements. Therefore, the characteristics and optimized of stadium lighting system based on BIM and Internet of things were proposed, and an example showed that the green stadium lighting energy saving design method under BIM technology has good feasibility and effectiveness. The research provides a certain theoretical basis and application support for the application of BIM technology in the field of green building.

articleTitle: Operation Evaluation of Multi-Source Coupling Heating System Based on TRNSYS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to alleviate the heating energy consumption in hot summer and cold winter areas is generally high, a variety of complementary and coupled clean energy heating will become the main form of energy supply. Taking a building in a certain area of Baotou City as the heating research object, TRNSYS software was used to establish the system operation model. Through the analysis of the heating condition of the solar collector in parallel with the auxiliary heating unit, the annual average energy efficiency ratio (COP) of the ground source heat pump and water tank combined heating is increased by 21.2% and the energy consumption is increased by 21.2% compared with that of the whole tank heating mode. A decrease of 3.23%. And in the analysis of environmental benefits, the results show that the ground source heat pump - water tank heating is better than the whole water tank heating mode.

articleTitle: Multi-scenario Dynamic Path Planning Method for Multiple Construction Robots Based on A * Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Multiple scenes refer to the same building, different places, different time, or space with a certain number of location relationships and common characteristics or similar attributes. Each building has its own unique functions and characteristics. Therefore, in the process of construction, it is necessary to take into account the important impact of multiple target users (i.e., robots) on the whole system due to their interaction, interaction and other factors. This paper studies and designs the path of the robot based on the multi-scene dynamic planning method. We will implement the whole model based on the A * algorithm. Firstly, the kinematics equation and mathematical model of the robot are established, and then the optimized parameters are solved by MATLAB software and the optimal solution is obtained in the actual situation; At last, a multi-level fusion strategy is given, and the simulation results are analyzed to verify the performance indicators and operation effects of the scheme. The test results show that the A * algorithm can be used to dynamically plan the path, explore the navigation and create the matrix map. The final table mapping is a subset of the table mapping corresponding to the actual environment. Therefore, after defining different starting points, destinations and navigation paths, the information recorded by the matrix map will be closer to the real environment information, making the environment information of the mobile robot clearer, and providing reference and guidance for similar engineering applications in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Livestock Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Exterior fencing is a long-term investment for cattle farm or Livestock. Physical fences help to protect cattle with latest IoT sensors. Biosecurity prevents reducing the spread of harmful diseases to cattle farm. IoT has changed the agricultural industry to next level. A topographical safety zone for cattle system is saved by the IoT sensors. Livestock monitoring, which was carried out manually using physical fences, has now been improved by using modern technology where they can be automatically tracked and monitored. IoT cattle tracking software provide a lot of benefits and security features that can acutely improve your livestock operations. The position of cattle can be easily tracked by Navigation satellites and the Global Positioning System (GPS). Effortlessly observing the Livestock management in cattle farm without farmers is improved by latest IoT sensors. IoT sensors collect data from livestock’s location, welfare of cattle. Extensive farming system will take care of animals in some welfare domains like nutrition, health, behavior.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of a Service Platform Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Blockchain has the characteristics of decentralization, stability, security, and tamper-proof. With the further improvement and application of blockchain technology, blockchain will be integrated with traditional industries such as finance, medical care, and logistics. This article aims to study the key technology of a service platform based on blockchain technology. Taking supply chain finance as an example, it analyzes the architecture and characteristics of blockchain, the principle of blockchain technology, and the combination of blockchain and supply chain financial service platforms. On the basis of meaning, a supply chain financial service system based on blockchain technology was designed, and the performance of the system was tested. The test results show that the system login success rate is 99.92%, the system response time is 1.91s on average, the CPU and memory usage rates are less than the target value, and the system performance can meet the expected target. In addition, the actual login success rate of the system tested in this article is 99.92%, and the actual system business success rate is 99.86%. The supply chain financial service system designed in this article based on blockchain technology has good performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of Human Age and Gender Using Deep Learning For Smart Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The demand for accurate identification and verification of a person has increased as the number of smart security systems has grown. In recent years, data from a human face has been used in numerous real-world applications, including social networking, security monitoring, advertising, and entertainment. Computer vision researchers have long been interested in this topic because automatic age and gender prediction from facial images is crucial for interpersonal communication. This work predicts that the gender will be either ‘Male’ or ‘Female,’ and that the age will be one of the following ranges: (0-5), (6-10), (11-17), (18-25), (25-32), (33-45), (46-55), (55-70). In the proposed system the images are preprocessed and then the convolutional neural networks are used to extract age and gender-related features and classified the images using the appropriate classifiers. The face images are taken from the UTK dataset and the proposed method achieved a training accuracy of 92.5% and a validation accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: VM Migration and Resource Management using Meta Heuristic Technique in Cloud Computing Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: An increasingly important component in the development of Cloud Computing, an Internet-based technology, is the optimization of its resources. To make the most of available resources, cloud data centre models need a resource management strategy. The Bin-Packing issue is a combinatorial optimization that may be used to efficiently assign virtual machines to physical machines. In this study, we present a two-stage approach for managing and allocating resources effectively. In the first step, we propose the Load Balanced Multi-Dimensional Bin-Packing (LBMBP) heuristics for allocating virtual machines (VMs) to physical machines (PMs or hosts) by taking into account all of the available resources at their disposal. As indicated in the second stage, a technique to identify overload and load balance hosts based on anomalies is necessary for VM migration. CloudSim Plus Simulator simulation results were used to demonstrate the planned work, and it was found that the number of operational PMs was reduced. Reduced energy use and emigration rates due to more efficient use of available resources.

articleTitle: Pharmaceutical Cold Chain Logistics Traceability System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's pharmaceutical industry, higher requirements are put forward for drug quality, supply chain control and traceability system. Based on blockchain technology, this paper builds and runs a set of traceability database. The data storage adopts the combination of the Internet of Things and distributed sensing for collection, transmission, analysis and processing to form a new traceability information base. A perfect and stable and controllable mechanism has been established through the database to ensure a good circulation environment for drugs from the source to the terminal, and to ensure that consumers' requirements for effective and rapid tracking and feedback control of product quality and supply chain control during the use process have been fully reflected. After that, the performance of the system was tested in this paper. The test results showed that the blockchain technology-based pharmaceutical cold chain logistics system has a fast data transmission time and high system operation efficiency, which can show that the system can meet user needs.

articleTitle: The Asymmetric Two Branch Network for Low Illumination Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Owing to the lack of ambient light, the visibility of low-light image is very low, the detail information is not clear, and it is difficult to obtain effective information. It is a great challenge to restore high-quality and clear image by using a single low-light image. Therefore, this paper proposes a method of enhancing low-light image by using different exposure images with two branch networks Firstly, the gamma transform is used to process the original lowillumination image to obtain the processed image with different exposure, and then the features of the images with different exposures are extracted by two different networks. Finally, a fusion network is used to effectively fuse the feature information extracted from the two branch networks to reconstruct the high-quality enhanced image. To make the enhanced image more natural, the two-branch network and fusion network are used as generators, Experiments show that the algorithm can get high quality images with clear details, improved contrast and nature. A low-light enhancement method based on Generative Adversarial Networks is proposed in this paper. For the model based on Generative Adversarial Networks proposed in this paper, it can improve the visibility of the image and make the image meet the visual quality of human eyes at the same time.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Multi Objective Reactive Power Optimization Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper discusses the Multi-Objective Reactive Power Analysis of the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, adjusts the transformation ratio of the on load regulating transformer, and changes the output measures of the reactive power compensation device, so that the system can achieve the optimization of multiple performance indicators under the premise of meeting the relevant constraints. The traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm has local extremum problem, and the optimization results are different from the actual results. In order to improve the limitations of particle swarm optimization, the simulated annealing algorithm is introduced to weight the PSO to improve the accuracy of calculation. The simulation results show that the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm optimizes the terminal voltage and reactive power compensation measures of reactive power target, and obtains a more effective power system optimization scheme. Therefore, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm provides more accurate guidance for multi-objective non-function analysis, and adjusts the terminal voltage and power compensation measures of reactive power target.

articleTitle: Advanced Secure Signature based Multipath Routing protocol for MANET using Density based Spatial Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: A mobile Adhoc network is a self-organizing, infrastructure-free network that operates without a centralized management system. Nodes depend on other nodes to keep the network linked to complex routes and companies depend on other companies to communicate between nodes. The mobile adhoc network recently developed and high-density areas, according to security, are an impossible problem. To overcome this problem, DBSCPR clustering algorithm based Advanced Secure Signature-based Multipath Routing (AS2MR) is proposed. The MANET is used to propose advanced secure signatures to support. The DBSCPR is a Good algorithm and reduces network route path selection. In AS2MR, cluster formation is performed by the DBSCPR algorithm with the balanced set. Energy consumption, obtained signal power, mobility, congestion rate, cooperation rate, and network lifetime are chosen as Cluster Head (CH) efficiency measurements to predict the degree of trust. The challenge of developing a guiding protocol for calculating large mobile ad hoc networks has been demonstrated in several studies. The Density-Based Spatial Clustering Presentation with Racket (DBSCPR) algorithm network architecture proposed in this article is designed to be compatible. Based on the location, Core point, boundary point, and noise point of the section, the package implementation divides data points into three categories. Uses information from above to build route finders and distributes traffic across several routes. The proposed estimation techniques compare the ratio level analysis, the efficient performance study of the divergent path recognition output based on infiltration detection, and the simulation results. As a result, the Discovery mechanism does not require flooding, which reduces overhead and develops knowledge replication.

articleTitle: Research on the Reconstruction of Galloping Curve of Transmission Line Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Galloping disasters have extremely bad effects on the operation of transmission lines, and the realization of galloping prediction is extremely necessary. The study takes the galloping sample data of the power system in Henan Province as an example to analyze the temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of meteorological data, meanwhile selects the BP neural network algorithm to complete the prediction of icing galloping on transmission lines. In line dancing prediction, the false alarm rate and false alarm rate of BP neural network algorithm are within a reasonable range. Compared with the other three prediction methods, the BP neural network algorithm has good performance in both the training set and the test set of transmission line icing galloping prediction The line galloping prediction results of the training set and the test set show that the BP neural network algorithm has ideal performance, and prediction accuracy rate increases by about 5-20%. The constructed transmission line ice galloping prediction model can give early warning of severe weather in time, ensuring the stability and safety of the power network. The research results can effectively control the hazards caused by grid galloping, improve the reliability level of transmission lines, and ensure the safety of the transmission system during peak winter.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Development of Smart Transmitter Estimation in Mobile Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Smart Transmitter (ST) parameter estimate presents a particular problem in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs). Nodes in these networks must develop the ability to adapt to their dynamic environment, which includes elements like the number, distribution, and topology of nodes. As a result, a distributed approach must be used to estimate the ST parameters. Distributed estimate of ST parameters is a difficult task, particularly in dynamic mobile ad hoc networks. This study suggests an intelligent design for estimating mobile ad hoc network-wise transmitters. This is because the ST parameters must be changed to reflect the nodes' constant need to adapt to the environment's constant change. However, the ST parameters in these networks can be precisely estimated with the appropriate methods and instruments.

articleTitle: Low Power Multiplier using SPST based on Kogge Stone Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Multipliers are important hardware components in most digital and high-speed systems, such as microprocessors, digital signal processors, and FIR filters. In reality, Multipliers, which are complicated units, are responsible for the total speed, size, and power consumption of digital systems. Multiplication in digital systems has a wide range of requirements for speed, size, power consumption, and other parameters. It comprises of partial product production, partial product reduction, and lastly carry-propagate addition. The Multiplier design focuses on minimizing power dissipation while still maintaining other parameters. To obtain considerable power savings in VLSI design, the dynamic power dissipation of multipliers must be reduced. The fundamental goal of this effort is to choose an appropriate adder that consumes less power, runs at a high speed, and is plainly less expensive. The available 8-bit adders, such as the Carry Select Adder, Ripple Carry Adder, Carry Look Ahead Adder, and Kogge Stone Adder, are investigated. Among the adders tested, the Kogge Stone Adder performs the best. This adder may be used to create efficient multipliers.

articleTitle: Exploration of Metalens Towards The Enhancement of Antenna Performances
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: For the proper utilization of RF signals available in the environment, there is an high requirement of efficient RF front-ends, which must witness strong circular polarization (CP) features and feasibility from design perspective with high CP antenna gain, strong radiation, and consistent antenna efficiency in the 3.5/5 GHz (sub-6 GHz bands). So, metalensinspired CP printed monopole is reported here in this paper. It attains broadband CP with fractional bandwidth of > 15%, CP gain of > 7.35 dBic, directional radiation pattern with a 3-dB angular beamwidth of > 100°-120° in the 3.5/5 GHz bands, along with improved front-to-back ratio (FBR) within the admissible limits. The attained outcomes subsequently matched with the performance trade-offs obtained from the state-of-the-art. In addition to it, comprehensive design reported for the widespread solution of the limitation, usually faced by the monopole antennas in the vast areas of the RF based urban transformation based on the 5G applications, especially in the lower 5G bands.

articleTitle: Unity3D Based on the Impact of Landscape Planning and Design Virtual and Realistic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the development and popularisation of 4G and 5G information technology, virtual technology has also ushered in a new year of development. In the past, the planning and design of landscaping mainly relied on CAD planar mapping technology, which made the mapping more accurate. Compared to traditional hand-drawing, this has been a huge step forward in the landscape design industry. However, this technology does not allow for both aesthetics. Unity3D-based landscape planning and design is both more accurate and more aesthetically pleasing. It also allows people to participate in the virtual environment and observe the landscape in detail, giving them an immersive experience. This paper will design a simulation runtime system based on the concepts and editors of the Unity3D engine technology, which will reflect the features and advantages of Unity3D by comparing it with other virtual mapping technologies. Finally, the effect of the use of Unity3D engine technology will be used to analyse the relevance of the technology in landscape design. In this paper, Sketch Up as the platform, using CAD software to model and produce the corresponding scene model, and then using Unity3D unreal engine to build a realistic three-dimensional landscape world, and finally realize the garden effect drawing function. Through comparative experiments, it is proved that the authenticity of landscape designed by Unity3D technology engine reaches 94.5%, while that of BIM and Open Scene Graph technology systems is 86.3% and 90.30% respectively. Therefore, the practical significance of Unity3D engine technology in landscape design.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Intrusion Detection System for Network Security Using Self-Organizing Map
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Machine learning techniques are widely used for detecting network attacks at the network level and the host level in a timely and automatic, to develop an intrusion detection system (IDS) for grading. Malicious attacks are always the need for change and scaling solutions, because it occurred during a very large volume, however, a number of challenges will occur. There is a data set that can be publicly available for further research on another malware of cyber security within the community. Network, plays an important role in modern life, has become the network security is an important field of research. Is an important network security technology Intrusion Detection System (IDS) being to monitor the software running on the network and hardware status. Despite the decades of development, the existing IDS, still, to reduce the improved error rate detection accuracy, are faced with the challenge of detecting unknown attacks. To overcome the issues proposed the method is Self-Organizing Map (SOM) Performance of intrusion detection depends mainly on the accuracy. Accuracy intrusion detection is to reduce the error rate, it must be strengthened in order to increase the detection rate. In order to improve performance, different technologies, have been used in recent works. It is the main work of the intrusion detection system for analyzing a huge network traffic data. Well-organized classification method, you need to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Radix-4 Adder with Variable Accuracy and Dynamic Output Modification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Approximate computing is an appropriate mechanism to lowering computational expenses. They require a necessity between computing precision and the consumption of power, lag elements, and the circuit. However, the approximate requirements for different applications may vary. By some terms, precise results are needed. As a result, this work offers an ACRA, which leverages the gating technique of power to dynamically turn high or low the partial logic gates of an adder element to calculate accurate or approximation results. When the ACRA is set to approximate mode, the partial sum of one adder element is changed to lessen the error distance between the approximate and accurate results. When compared to adjustable adders, the ACRA obtained the optimum necessary between power-lag product and computational accuracy. Furthermore, figure processing result done in this work, the ACRA's PSNR was reduced to 1 dB and its index value was greater than 0.99. The outperform of previous accuracy-configurable adders.

articleTitle: The Design Scheme of OCR and Analysis Platform for Power Meter Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new design scheme for an OCR platform. The scheme first pre-trains the model on a standard dataset to improve its basic recognition ability, and then fine-tunes the pre-trained model using transfer learning techniques to a custom scenario, thus improving its recognition ability in power industry applications. This approach greatly reduces the need for annotated data and can quickly adapt to new meter types and updates. Additionally, an intelligent data collection, processing, and analysis platform can effectively help power companies monitor, measure, diagnose, and predict equipment and meters, thereby enhancing enterprise safety and stability. By introducing transfer learning-related techniques, the model’s knowledge learned on a standard dataset is transferred to a custom scenario, improving its recognition ability in power industry-specific applications and achieving rapid warning and diagnosis of abnormal situations in power equipment, further improving production efficiency and safety of the enterprise.

articleTitle: The Performanc Enhancements of Interference Management in Complex Wireless Personal Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Wireless personal area networks (WPANs) are becoming increasingly complex as the number of applications and the amount of data being transmitted increases. Interference management is an important aspect of WPANs, as it can affect the overall performance of the network. Interference management techniques enable WPANs to operate effectively by minimizing interference between co-located devices, managing the power levels of transmitters, and preventing unauthorized access. The most common interference management technique used in WPANs is frequency hopping. Frequency hopping allows a device to use multiple frequencies in a coordinated manner, so that the same frequency is not used at the same time by two or more devices. This reduces interference between devices, improves signal quality, and increases network throughput. Another technique is power management. Power management allows devices to reduce the amount of power they transmit, which reduces interference from nearby devices. Finally, security measures such as encryption can be used to prevent unauthorized access to the network. Interference management is essential to ensure that WPANs operate effectively and efficiently. Without proper interference management, the performance of the WPAN could be significantly degraded due to interference between devices. Therefore, it is important to implement strategies to minimize interference and maximize the performance of a WPAN.

articleTitle: Cross-border Website Evaluation based on Web E-commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This article provides an intelligent cross-border e-commerce website safety and quality assessment method and system, involving the field of artificial intelligence technology. Through big data collection and data crawling, cross-border e-commerce website database collection is obtained, and commercial release information collection of various e-commerce websites is obtained. Based on the above information, e-commerce website safety and quality assessment models and website product safety and quality assessment models are constructed, Combine the two to generate a cross-border e-commerce website security and quality evaluation model to evaluate e-commerce website data information, and mark those that meet the website quality eligibility threshold as trusted e-commerce websites. The present invention solves the technical problem that judging the quality of cross-border e-commerce websites in the prior art still relies on manually opening a webpage to click and browse, resulting in low efficiency and poor accuracy in the quality judgment process. It realizes automatic data crawling and scoring of cross-border e-commerce websites, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of judging the quality of cross-border e-commerce websites.

articleTitle: Enhanced Video Streaming Based Computing Encoder for Digital Visual Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The rise of video streaming for digital visual processing has been a boon for the industry of visual processing. Video streaming technology has made it easier for companies to capture, analyze, and interpret visual data faster than ever before. It has allowed for the storage and transmission of large amounts of visual data at high speeds, providing businesses with the ability to process and interpret this data in real-time. Video streaming technology can be used in a wide variety of applications, including facial recognition, 3D mapping, and object recognition. By streaming video data, companies can quickly and accurately identify individuals, recognize objects, and track movement. This technology can also be used in security applications, such as surveillance and monitoring, as well as in medical imaging, such as MRI and CT scans. Video streaming technology has also allowed companies to create more efficient visual processing systems. The streaming video data can be used to automate the process of image recognition and object classification. This has allowed companies to reduce the amount of time and effort needed to interpret visual data. Additionally, streaming video data can be used to create virtual reality experiences, providing users with an immersive experience when viewing digital images.

articleTitle: Application of Modern Information Education Technology in Physical Education Teaching and Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Information and communication technology (ICT) has become an important tool in the field of sports. Since the computer was introduced into physical education, the application of IET in physical education has become more and more common. The purpose of this study is to explore how modern information technology can be applied to physical education and training through computer exercises, simulations and games. Information and communication technology can be used to strengthen the teaching process, especially physical education. The use of information and communication technology can help teachers improve their knowledge, skills and content knowledge, and provide students with more opportunities for self-study. The use of modern information technology tools, such as interactive whiteboard (IWB), computerized exercise program and video recording system, has been introduced into physical education teaching and training at all levels from primary school to university.

articleTitle: Protection and Utilization of Personal Information in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the innovation of technology, the amount of data has doubled and people have entered the era of big data. As one of the important resources, the economic and social value of data is increasing, but in the process of sharing, processing, circulation, and use of data, how to achieve a balance between the protection and utilization has become a key issue affecting national security today. Firstly, this paper presents the significance of this research based on the analysis of high-profile cases in recent years; Secondly, the current situation at national and international will be analyzed in two directions; national legislation and technical research; Thirdly, a summary of current problems. Finally, solutions are proposed on how to achieve the protection and use of personal information.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Immune Algorithm in Logistics Distribution Center Problem Based on Ternary Optical Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: To break the bottleneck of computing speed, bandwidth, and power consumption of electronic computers, in recent years, as an emerging computer, the ternary optical computer (TOC) has attracted much attention because of its own mega-parallelism, and as the theory and practice of optical computing technology continue to develop and enrich, the exploration of applications based on ternary optical computer is also advancing. Logistics distribution center (LDC) problem is one of the core issues in the study of logistics networks. A sensible logistics center distribution can improve the efficiency of goods transportation and the operation efficiency of logistics enterprises. Traditional immune algorithms are prone to premature convergence and insufficient local search capability. By introducing a linear selection strategy, the algorithm maintains population diversity. The introduction of Gaussian and Cauchy mutation (G&C mutation) allows the algorithm to jump out of the local optimum. The experimental results show that the algorithm has higher solution quality and better robustness and can solve the logistics center location problem under the given constraints efficiently, and compared to electronic computers, TOC is more efficient.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network for Printed circuit Board Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: One of the most important steps in the manufacturing of electronic goods is the creation of printed circuit boards (PCB). An electronic device's PCBs are the first stage in production, so even a small error there could cause serious flaws in the finished product. Finding and identifying flaws in PCBs is crucial given the size and demand of the PCB industry. In this paper, we propose a reference comparison method for PCB defect localization and classification that employs a template and a test picture and integrates machine learning and image processing techniques. We introduce a solution pipeline that works in three stages: Subtraction of Images where the test images are subtracted to generate a mask that highlights the regions of defect on the test image, Contour search to find the contour of the defects from the generated test image, and Model Inference where the contours found above are extracted from the images and fed into our machine learning model which then classifies those defects in the test image. We train the machine learning model, in our case, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that forms the artificially intelligent (AI) part of our solution which can identify the type of defect present given the image of the defect as input. Our experimental findings demonstrate that, compared to other traditional methods utilized for this work, our model diagnoses the afflicted parts with 97% accuracy.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation of Higher Education based on Intuitionistic Fuzzy Information
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The quality evaluation of higher education is a complex problem. It involves many factors such as teaching quality, learning environment, student motivation, etc. This study aims to explore the relationship between higher education quality evaluation and fuzzy information. Quality assessment can be defined as “the process of assessing whether a product has achieved its intended purpose” (Bryman, 2011). Quality assessment has been widely used in different sectors such as healthcare, banking and other industries. In addition to evaluating products or services, it also includes evaluating people’s classroom teaching as a teaching method that has been adopted by Chinese universities. The quality of classroom teaching directly affects the quality of national talent cultivation. Therefore, how to scientifically evaluate the teaching quality of teachers has become a major issue for the current scientific and standardized teaching management in colleges and universities.
